motion.name: hero-entrance

motion.name: hero-scroll-story
motion.value: start: top top; end: bottom bottom; scrub: 0.65; ease: power2.inOut
motion.purpose: One ordinary-scroll timeline separates five objects in position, rotation and depth, then reassembles them. The rig scales to 0.66 during separation; phone translation/depth strength is 0.65. No wheel interception.

motion.name: hero-scroll-layout
motion.purpose: Enhanced hero only. Static reduced-motion and no-JavaScript states retain natural height. Pausing preserves this layout distance.

motion.name: listening-rail
motion.value: strokeDashoffset: 1 → 0; duration: 0.8 timeline units; ease: none
motion.purpose: Draws Brief → Recordings → Sequence → Cover with the hero scroll story. Decorative annotations fade in at 0.18 and out at 0.62 timeline units.

motion.name: heading-reveal
motion.value: words,lines; mask: lines; autoSplit: true; aria: auto; duration: 0.85s hero / 0.7s sections; stagger: 0.055s; ease: expo.out
motion.purpose: Hero words enter once; selected section headings reveal at top 92%. Body copy is not split or hidden.

motion.name: fine-pointer-feedback
motion.value: tilt: 10deg X / 14deg Y range; duration: 0.7s; ease: power3.out; button factors: x 0.06 / y 0.1; duration: 0.3s
motion.purpose: Stage tilt and light attraction on hero/artwork-story buttons only for fine hover pointers while motion is enabled and unpaused.

motion.name: cover-story-turn
motion.value: rotation: -8deg; scale: 0.86; scrub: 0.5; start: top bottom; end: center center
motion.purpose: The cover-story figure settles as it scrolls into view.

motion.name: journey-arrow-draw
motion.value: strokeDashoffset: 40 → 0; duration: 0.45s; stagger: 0.1s; ease: power2.out; start: top 85%
motion.purpose: Draws the existing journey arrows once on entry.

motion.name: action-background-color
motion.purpose: Button color feedback uses the default CSS ease.

motion.name: brand-and-navigation
motion.purpose: Hover feedback on the existing groove mark and text navigation.

motion.name: pressed-and-kept-controls
motion.value: button/reroll active scale: 0.97; checked checkbox scale: 1.12; checkbox transition: scale 160ms ease-out
motion.purpose: Compact press feedback and native Keep checkbox state. The primary arrow moves 3px on hover with a 150ms ease-out transition.

motion.name: brief-reroll-feedback
motion.purpose: Answer text changes immediately and a polite live region announces it. Decorative GSAP feedback is skipped when paused or reduced.

motion.name: pause-motion
motion.value: tracked animations progress(1).pause(); scroll triggers disabled; pointer/button offsets reset
motion.purpose: Settles readable content, retains the enhanced hero layout, changes aria-pressed and the Resume motion label, and removes CSS transition/animation timing. Resume re-enables triggers and refreshes scroll geometry.

motion.name: anchor-scroll
motion.purpose: HTML anchor scrolling outside reduced-motion mode.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: GSAP context inactive/reverted; transition: none !important; animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Static composed artwork and rail, normal headings and natural non-sticky height. Preference changes revert the enhancement. Form text/status updates remain immediate.

Sample listening brief60 min
Make me a 60-minute Apple Music playlist for: the long way home. Warm, textured and a little unexpected. Mostly discoveries, with a few familiar anchors. No live versions. Avoid consecutive songs by the same artist. Choose exact recordings, explain the listening flow, and show me the playlist before creating it. Suggest an original cover direction too.

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, compact sans-serif controls and generous serif headlines frame original music artwork. The site feels editorial and tactile: thin dividers organize the page, raspberry identifies actions, and olive provides a distinct working surface for the brief composer. In the hero, a vinyl record, paper sleeve, flowing tape and two covers form a sculpture that separates and reassembles with scrolling.

This is a scan of the implemented website, not a product-wide identity specification. It covers the landing page, brief composer and explicit Starlight overrides. It does not govern the MCP App. The north-star phrase and atmosphere language are descriptive and provisional. The unattended implementation did not establish a user-selected comp or a public seed reference; the later direction roll does not replace that missing pre-implementation workshop. The user subsequently selected the surreal record-sculpture direction and requested the exploded motion recorded in [the motion brief](docs/design/site-motion-brief.md); that selected artwork direction is not a full-page comp approval. Documentation records observed design, not whole-surface ship approval. See [the website brief](docs/design/site-brief.md) for the process record.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper and dark ink support long reading; raspberry distinguishes actions.
Fraunces supplies headings and the composed brief; DM Sans supplies prose and controls.
Flat interface surfaces use thin dividers and tonal changes, while imagery carries physical texture.
Five independent hero layers supply depth and scroll motion; body copy and setup links remain readable.
The brief remains selectable, wraps naturally and grows with its content on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Surface Focus Rule
rules.body: Use the raspberry focus outline on paper, including the paper panel inside the olive section. Use the warm light outline on the olive working surface. The nested paper panel must restore its own focus color.

rules.name: The Type Role Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for editorial headings and the composed listening brief. Use DM Sans for explanations, field labels, actions and navigation.

rules.name: The Flat Interface Rule
rules.body: Separate interface surfaces through tone, spacing and thin dividers. Reserve the existing diffuse cover shadow for artwork inside the hero sculpture; do not transfer it to interface panels or controls.

rules.name: The Readable Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate the artwork and bounded heading reveals while preserving ordinary body copy, working setup links and document scrolling. Motion adds relationships; it does not gate access to the brief or setup.

rules.name: The Hydration Honesty Rule
rules.body: Keep the question fieldset and copy button disabled until the Svelte component mounts. Server-rendered output is labeled “Sample listening brief”; hydration changes the heading to “Your listening brief.” Without JavaScript the sample remains focusable and selectable, with an explanatory note and no enabled controls that imply a working composer. Disabled selects and textarea dim and use the disabled cursor.

dos: Do reuse the existing paper, ink, raspberry and olive roles before adding another palette.
Do keep original music artwork distinct from interface surfaces and preserve its aspect ratio.
Do keep visible keyboard focus appropriate to the immediate surface, including nested paper panels.
Do let the composed brief wrap and grow so its complete text remains inspectable and selectable.
Do preserve the single-column phone flow, static reduced-motion/no-JavaScript artwork and readable paused state.
Do keep composer controls disabled until hydration while leaving the sample brief selectable.
donts: Don't infer a dark landing-page theme from the separate Starlight dark accent overrides.
Don't transfer the hero cover shadow to interface panels or controls.
Don't make scroll animation or heading reveals a condition of reading, setup or brief access.
Don't turn the page-specific hero columns, step labels or brief questions into mandatory patterns for every future surface.
Don't treat this observed system, generated tonal ramps or provisional atmosphere language as evidence of user approval or release qualification.
